brief:
Israeli soldiers' testimonies have disclosed new details about a massacre committed by the occupation in Jabalia refugee camp, northern Gaza, on October 31, 2023, when Israeli airstrikes destroyed residential buildings, according to Shehab Wire. The soldiers' accounts reveal that the occupation had calculated an anticipated death toll of 300 before carrying out the operation.

The disclosure adds to documented accounts of the Jabalia incident, one of several operations in northern Gaza during the initial phase of the war that resulted in heavy civilian casualties.
